context: Two managers prep an official press-release timeline
purpose: Teach: 稼い/及ば/導く/禁じ/新着/実在/事典/オフィシャル

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィシャル発表のタイムライン、もう新着情報として出していい段階ですか？
lines.en: Can we already put out the official announcement timeline as breaking news?
lines.style: Polite but slightly pressing, checking with a peer manager before committing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いや、まだ数字が確定に及ばないから、社外への共有は禁じておこう。
lines.en: No, the numbers haven't reached final form yet, so let's prohibit external sharing.
lines.style: Calm and measured, drawing a clear professional line with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 了解です。広報のタイミングを正しい順序に導くのは、やっぱり私たちの役目ですね。
lines.en: Understood. Steering the PR timing into the right order really is our job.
lines.style: Agreeable and reflective, acknowledging shared managerial responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そう。去年はそこで稼いだ信頼を、一度の勇み足で失いかけたからね。
lines.en: Right. Last year one hasty move nearly cost us the trust we'd earned.
lines.style: Reminiscent and cautionary, speaking from experience as a senior colleague.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では文面の固有名詞は、社内の人名事典で実在の部署名と必ず照合します。
lines.en: Then I'll cross-check every proper noun against our internal name directory.
lines.style: Practical and detail-oriented, proposing a concrete verification step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かる。実在しない肩書きが一つでも混じれば、オフィシャルサイトの信用が崩れる。
lines.en: That helps. One fake title slips in and the official site's credibility crumbles.
lines.style: Grateful yet sober, emphasizing the high stakes of small errors.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: それと配信予約は十六時、新着順で上位固定にしておきますね。
lines.en: Also I'll schedule the release for four, pinned at the top of new posts.
lines.style: Efficient and forward-looking, locking in operational logistics.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいね。じゃあ最終確認は十五時半、それに合わせて原稿を仕上げておいてくれ。
lines.en: Good. Final check at three thirty, please have the draft polished by then.
lines.style: Decisive and directive, closing the meeting with clear next steps.
